page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew and Aramaic script; running head at top; catchword/signature "C 2" at foot.

main_text.p: אילך Ch. Ultra, Ulterius, מִכָּן וְאֵילָךְ. Hinc & ulterius, Esth.2.14.
אלל Ch. Explorare, Scrutari. Pahel אַלֵּל Idem. Partic. מְאַלִּין Exploratores, Jos.2.1.
אליל Ch. Idolum, Res nihili, Jobi13.4.
אלול Ch. Nomen mensis, Augusto noftro refpon- dens.
אלם Ch. Robuftum, Fortem effe. Ithpahel אִתְאַלַּם Idem. Item Obmutefcere, Pfal.39.3.10. Eccl. 12.7. Pahel Partic. אַרוּם מְאַלְּמָא הִיא Quod obfirmata, vel obftinato animo effet, Ruth.1.18.
אלים Ch. Fortis, Robuftus. Plur. אֵלִימִין.
אלמה Hebr. Manipulus. Hinc plur. אֲלוּמַיָּא Ch. Manipuli, Ruth.2.15.
אולמא, אולמא, אולם Ch. Porticus, Vestibulum. Plur. אולמי Ezech.41.15.
*אלמונין Ch. Ligna Thyina, vel Corallium, ut Hebraei interpretantur, 1.Reg.10.11.
אלמלי, אלמלא Ch. Si, Nisi, Si non, Psl.106.23.
אלין, אלין Ch. [illegible, ~6 letters] Syr. Illi, Illae, Illa, Isti, Istae, Ista. Pronom. generis communis.
אילנא, אילן Chald. & Syr. Arbor. Plur. אילנין, emphat. אילניא.
אלף Ch. & Syr. Discere. Pahel אַלֵּף Discere facere, Docere: Ithpah. אִתְאַלֵּף Idem. Vide quoq; ילף.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic words are transcribed approximately from the scan; vocalisation marks may be imperfect. The Syriac word after "Ch." in the entry beginning אלין is illegible.
